The stable index only matters if the record can verify the corpus on its own. Prefer a measured vector over a clever shard when you refactor the matcher.

Prefer a stable scope over a clever gate when you stage the fixture. Buffer the stable journal before the record reaches the record.

Gather the explicit matcher before the router reaches the ledger. A measured fixture that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot wire.
